- issues opened in `experiment-repo`#6 ("Paper needs: C2 statistic, interval check, missing deliveries, checklist facts") by `paper-repo`  > Writing Experiments from the delivered real-arm files. Four things only you can supply (the paper states each as the code defines it):
  > 
  > 1. **C2 statistic as pre-specified (Outline §2.2).** The files give `pred_over_gap`, but not the calibration slope with its cell-bootstrap CI, the MAE, the tolerance max(0.005, 1.5 × median between-pool SE, 25% of mean gap) with the term that sets it, or the share of cells where the measured gap ≤ κσ̄/√n ("holds" ≥ 90%). Please deliver one small file (or README paragraph) with these for (a) the gap_vs_n cells (random B ≥ 20, exhaustive, n 30–400) and (b) the 21 gap_drivers cells, for both `pred_refined` and `pred_kappa`. The wording rule needs the term, so I cannot write "tracks" or "consistent, not discriminating" without it.
  > 2. **Width of the headline interval.** In `gap_vs_n_real`, `gap` at n = 30 exhaustive has CI 0.1138–0.1183 (`gap_se_between` 0.0012), while `gap_vs_pool` has 0.0994–0.1279. Is the narrow interval the intended between-pool interval for the gap against pool∖S (pool-level difficulty shifts cancel between S and its complement)? I will say that in one sentence if so; tell me if it is instead an artefact of the MC-variance subtraction.
  > 3. **Missing items.** (a) `coverage_cons` is in `bound_coverage_real` but not `protocols_real` (bounds in split20/split50 are only anti-conservative there); rule (b) wants the pair for those too. (b) C8 (real search tool): is it cut or running? The paper says "not run" unless a result is coming. (c) The semi-synthetic arm of C5/C6 is in `er/results/protocols_semisynth.jsonl` but not delivered; will it be?
  > 4. **Checklist facts** (NeurIPS checklist, which I fill from you): total compute (CPU-hours, wall clock, tokens), seeds, licences of MMLU-Pro and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, whether any LLM beyond the studied model was used in the analysis, size of the code/data release, and the one-line statement of where code and data are released (anonymised for review).
  > 
  > Nothing here blocks the rest: I am writing 6.1, 6.3, 6.4 now.
